title: Scheming Detection via Output Entropy Monitoring

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Moderate chain: entropy-based scheming detection -> lightweight real-time monitor. However, the hypothesis that scheming produces distinctive entropy patterns is speculative and may not hold. Requires empirical validation of a weak prior.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires open-source models with accessible logits, generating outputs in normal and scheming conditions, and computing token-level entropy. Logit access and entropy computation add moderate technical complexity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Need to: generate matched outputs in two conditions, compute entropy sequences, build classifier, test. Bounded but requires scheming elicitation methodology plus statistical analysis. Feasible in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
